$comment: MACHINE-READABLE ATTRIBUTE DELTA for the FlowX onboarding spec, v1.5.01 -> v1.6.0. Written for an automated agent updating the Databricks App (databricks-app/). Every path below is expressed as it appears in an onboarding spec document, rooted at the spec object; [] denotes an array element. IMPORTANT FOR CONSUMERS: unlike prior deltas, the v1.6.0 app-side work was applied IN THE SAME RELEASE -- each entry's app_state says whether any action remains. Verify against databricks-app/web/src/registry.js and config/registry/*.json before re-applying anything.

breaking: reconciliation_result is now gated by logging_config.run_log_capture (previously written unconditionally) -- any monitoring that expects a result row for every reconciliation run breaks for suppressed-logging flows
source_plane.catalog/schema null no longer publishes L0 nodes into the hosting pipeline's own schema -- shared nodes default to pipeline-scoped temporary tables invisible in Unity Catalog

staged intermediates (_<t>_staged when materialized) and reconciliation L3/L4 intermediates are no longer published to Unity Catalog; on an already-deployed pipeline the first v1.6.0 update renames/unpublishes them (streaming state resets -- see migration notes in docs/13)
summary.headline: v1.6.0: the Intermediate Object Rule (intermediates are @dlt.view or temporary tables, never published), reconciliation logging_config now gates dataset registration and reconciliation_result, sink_config.staged_file_format adds CSV staging to pgp_zip exports, and the app removes every display-only default (UI empty/OFF == key absent in JSON).
summary.app_ui_change_without_spec_change: All display-only defaults were removed from the app (web/src/registry.js d: values, config/registry/*.json default: entries, the hardcoded APPEND cdc_load_strategy) so the UI state and the exported JSON can no longer disagree: an untouched field renders empty/OFF and emits no key. This changes no spec attribute semantics -- absent keys keep their framework defaults.

added.default_behaviour: Absent == 'json' == the exact pre-v1.6.0 behaviour: the pgp_zip sink stages each non-empty partition's rows as a JSON-Lines file before zipping. No existing spec changes meaning.

enum_meanings.json: JSON-Lines staged files (one json.dumps(row) per line, default=str for non-native types). The pre-v1.6.0 behaviour and the default.
enum_meanings.csv: RFC-4180 CSV staged files with a header row; header order follows the sink's write schema; one staged .csv per non-empty partition per micro-batch (each with its own header); None stages as an empty cell; nested struct/array values stage as JSON text.

added.verbatim_rejection_message_for_non_pgp_z: target_config.sink_config.staged_file_format: only meaningful for format 'pgp_zip' (this framework's staging-then-archive sink); format '<format>' is a native Lakeflow sink with no staging step. Remove the attribute.
added.ui_position: In the sink_config section, immediately after sink_config.path, visible only when sink_config.format == 'pgp_zip'.
added.app_state: already_applied -- web/src/registry.js and config/registry/shared.target.json carry the field (options ['', 'json', 'csv'], no default, visible_when format==pgp_zip); config/validation/rules.json rule id 'staged_file_format_pgp_zip_only' mirrors the rejection; attribute_knowledge regenerated. No action remains.

modified.previous: run_log_capture gated reconciliation_run_log; mismatch_log_capture gated reconciliation_mismatch_log; reconciliation_result was ALWAYS written regardless; the recon__*__metrics/__mismatch pipeline datasets were always registered.
modified.current: run_log_capture (default true) gates reconciliation_run_log AND reconciliation_result AND, in pipeline mode, whether the recon__*__metrics dataset is registered at all; mismatch_log_capture gates reconciliation_mismatch_log and the recon__*__mismatch dataset. Both false == reconciliation persists ONLY to its business target tables: no metric/log dataset is created and no control-table row is written. Runtime overrides (recon_run_log_capture/recon_mismatch_log job parameters; dataflow.recon.run_log_capture/dataflow.recon.mismatch_log pipeline conf) keep their precedence and now also drive the graph-definition decision.
modified.migration: A flow relying on reconciliation_result rows while setting run_log_capture: false must either re-enable run_log_capture or move its monitoring to the pipeline/job run state and structured log events.
modified.ui_action: None required beyond the defaults removal (both toggles now render OFF-looking only when explicitly false; absent emits no key and the framework default true applies). app_state: already_applied.

modified.previous: null meant 'publish materialized L0 source-plane nodes into the hosting pipeline's own catalog' -- every shared node became a published table.
modified.current: null means the shared node is NOT published: it is registered as @dlt.table(temporary=True) under its bare name -- materialized once per update (read-once holds) but never visible in Unity Catalog. Set catalog AND schema together to publish deliberately.
modified.migration: A consumer that queried _src__<locator>__<8hex>__{stream,batch} tables from outside the pipeline must set source_plane.catalog + source_plane.schema explicitly to keep them published.
modified.ui_action: Help text update only (attribute_knowledge). app_state: already_applied (knowledge regenerated).

modified.previous: null meant the hosting pipeline's own schema.
modified.current: See source_plane.catalog -- null means unpublished temporary node; both must be set to publish.

rejections_added.rule: reconciliation_flows[].dq_config.rules present while logging_config.run_log_capture is false
rejections_added.verbatim_message_validator: <label>.run_log_capture: false is incompatible with dq_config.rules -- the flow's expectations attach to its recon__*__metrics dataset, which is only registered when run_log_capture is true (v1.6.0). Remove the dq_config rules or re-enable run_log_capture.
rejections_added.verbatim_message_runtime: Reconciliation flow '<id>': dq_config.rules are declared but run_log_capture resolves to false. The flow's expectations attach to its `__metrics` dataset, which is only registered when run_log_capture is true -- suppressing it would silently drop declared data-quality expectations. Either remove logging_config.run_log_capture: false (or the dataflow.recon.run_log_capture pipeline-conf override), or remove dq_config from this reconciliation flow.

rejections_added.rule: reconciliation_flows[].execution_mode == 'pipeline_audit_only' with both logging_config flags false
rejections_added.verbatim_message_validator: <label>: execution_mode 'pipeline_audit_only' with both run_log_capture and mismatch_log_capture false registers compute with no output at all (v1.6.0 -- the audit-only mode exists solely to produce the metrics/mismatch datasets and their control-table exports). Enable at least one capture flag, or use execution_mode 'job'/'pipeline'.
<path>.staged_file_format: only meaningful for format 'pgp_zip' (this framework's staging-then-archive sink); format '<format>' is a native Lakeflow sink with no staging step. Remove the attribute.

dataset_surface_delta.$comment: Not spec attributes, but catalog-visible objects an operator or BI tool may reference. What disappears from Unity Catalog under the v1.6.0 Intermediate Object Rule.
no_longer_published: <node_catalog>.<node_schema>._src__<locator>__<8hex>__{stream,batch} (L0 source-plane nodes, unless source_plane.catalog+schema explicitly set)
<catalog>.<publish_schema>._recon__<id>__src and __tgt for NON-healing flows (now temporary; healing flows keep them published)
conditionally_published: recon__<id>__<target>__metrics -- registered only when run_log_capture resolves true
recon__<id>__<target>__mismatch -- registered only when mismatch_log_capture resolves true
still_published_unchanged: flow target tables, quarantine tables, SCD2 <target>_current, _<target>_snapshot_input, _<target>_scd2_history

app_update_checklist: DONE (this release): remove every display-only default from web/src/registry.js (22 select d:, 6 bool d:true, defaultsFor() injections, non-blank 'blank' presets) and Builder.jsx (generate_hash_columns d:true, the ||'APPEND' strategy fallback).
DONE (this release): remove all 44 'default:' entries from config/registry/*.json and the hardcoded APPEND injection in server/core/registry.py.

DONE (this release): add target_config.sink_config.staged_file_format to web/src/registry.js + config/registry/shared.target.json + attribute_knowledge.curated.json; regenerate config/attribute_knowledge.json.
DONE (this release): add the three validation rules named in rejections_added to config/validation/rules.json.
DONE (this release): npm run build in databricks-app/web (dist bundle regenerated).
REMAINING: none. A future agent should verify rather than re-apply.

runtime_modules: reconciliation/graph_registration.py (conditional __metrics/__mismatch, temporary L3/L4, classified-anchored heal ordering edge, graph-time guards)
